title: GitLab has remediated an issue in GitLab CE/EE affecting all versions before 19.3.9, 19.4 before 19.4.8, and 19.5…
description: A vulnerability in GitLab CE/EE versions before 19.3.9, 19.4 before 19.4.8, and 19.5 before 19.5.6 could allow an authenticated user with an unconfirmed email address to be automatically granted Group Owner-level membership during a group import operation. This occurs due to insufficient enforcement of email verification in the member identity mapping process.
